title: sr Team leader
description:
**Essential Functions/Core Responsibilities**
---------------------------------------------

* Lead Team Members, foster their professional development and growth via effective coaching and communication and promote teamwork and cooperation

* Coach direct reports on their performance on a regular basis to ensure performance metrics are achieved

* Identify performance related issues, develop an action plan for improvement, implement corrective action, up to and including termination of employment

* Ensure service delivered to our customers meets contractual Key Performance Indicator (‘KPIs’) and financial expectations

* Communicate expectations to employees and provide timely updates and changes

* Provide subject matter expertise in handling escalated customer calls as needed

* Manage team metrics and retention goals. Participate in discussions about reasons for attrition and root cause. Team with Site Leadership to develop actions to reduce attrition where possible. Provide feedback to team members on both call coaching and other daily performance and behavioral activities

* Stay current on internal work processes, policies and procedures. Attend required manager development training

* Supervision of a group of call center associates including work and attendance monitoring in accordance with organization policy and applicable legal requirements

* Complete shift-wide projects that aim to increase productivity, quality or other KPI

* Promote the Company's values through both behavior and attitude, including being an advocate for your team members

**Candidate Profile**
---------------------

* Associate's degree in related field with four to six years of experience (with at least one year of Progressive Management Experience) preferred

* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal

* Demonstrated ability to lead team in multi-tasking, prioritization, and meeting timelines on deliverables

* Demonstrated ability to mentor, coach and provide direction to a team of employees

* Work well under pressure and follow through on items to completion

* Willingness to work a flexible schedule

**Career Framework Role**
-------------------------

Receives assignments as objectives with goals and processes in which to meet the goals. Interacts with Team Managers/Leaders/Supervisors and team members, other functional areas, management, and outside vendors to complete objectives. Set priorities for Team Managers/Leaders/Supervisors and team members , and coordinates and supervises the daily activities. In charge of handling large and / or multiple lines of business. Drives direct reports to achieve set metrics and business goals thru coaching, mentoring and providing regular feedback. Decisions are guided by policies, procedures and business plan; receives guidance and oversight from manager and/or director. Depending on the size of the program may act as an Operations Manager.

**Disclaimer**
--------------

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by people assigned to this job. They are not intended to be an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of personnel working within this job title.

title: L&D Manager, Global Learning and Development, Fulfillment by Amazon
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

The WW FBA Learning and Development Team executes our learning and development strategy for new hires and existing associates, including leadership. The Learning and Development (L&D) Team ensures our organization has the skills and knowledge to deliver excellence daily.
  
  
We seek an experienced L&D Manager to manage our APAC team and deliver various high-quality training programs. You will become an expert in our processes, and liaise with stakeholders and global leaders to ensure training deliverables meet standards and produce desired outcomes. You will have experience driving project throughput and can work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment. You are able to juggle competing priorities, be scrappy when necessary, and handle ambiguity comfortably. You must have a passion for relationship-building, as well as data efficiency and accuracy.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  
In this role, you will:  

* Help define global L&D strategy and serve as the single threaded owner for training and development in your region in support of that strategy, fostering the development and growth of employees.
* Manage a regional team that owns and supports global initiatives; set objectives and drive measurable improvement.
* Oversee the development, coordination, and delivery of trainings in APAC, including AI, business skills, new hire, functional, and leadership training as needed. Modalities may include instructor led training, workshops, videos, digital self-directed modules, and other materials.
* Scope, plan, manage, and execute complex learning and people development projects, including strategy and tactically driving teams to deliver.
* Review and validate training materials, curriculum plans, and learner engagement strategies.
* Build strong relationships with stakeholders and drive alignment on requirements, KPIs, prioritization, and action toward goals.
* Run mechanisms to collect, analyze, and report on learning impact metrics for your region.
* Identify knowledge gaps, training opportunities, and improvement initiatives.
* Mentor and coach learning experience designers and trainers.
* Ensure team adheres to established L&D standards, systems, and best practices.
* Maintain clear and consistent project status reporting for project partners and leadership.

  
A day in the life  

* Scope, plan, manage, and execute concurrent and complex learning initiatives across multiple domains and stakeholders
* Identify, assess and mitigate risks, drive resolution of critical issues, provide escalation management, anticipate and make tradeoffs and propose corrective actions to keep initiatives moving forward
* Coach and mentor the team
* Deep dive data and work with cross-functional teams to ensure employee growth and development
* Report on key initiatives to stakeholders and senior leadership

  
About the team  
Our vision is to empower our people by providing effective learning opportunities to develop their skills and knowledge. Our global cross-functional team is passionate about achieving this vision. We are highly collaborative and enjoy working together.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5+ years of cross functional project delivery experience
* 5+ years of program or project management experience
* 5+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
* Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements
* Experience managing teams

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
* 5+ years of learning design, learning science, instructional design, educational psychology, or similar field experience

  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Asset Serving Associate
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**  
  
  

Shape the future of Custody Operations by leading complex break resolution and oversight work while building career growth through high-visibility partnerships and delivery.

As a Custody Operations Breaks Management Associate within Custody Operations Breaks Management and Oversight, you will support front-to-end processing for 1700+ clients with ＄27.8 trillion in assets under custody across 100 global markets. You will investigate complex break activity, strengthen risk and control execution, and elevate reporting through disciplined program management. You will build trusted relationships across Operations, Product, Change Management, and Technology while supporting an inclusive, high-performing environment.

**Job Responsibilities:**

* Certify periodic account coverage across custody to maintain consistency in reporting.
* Investigate complex issues and enquiries related to nostro and internal breaks, including timely identification, escalation, and remediation actions.
* Oversee regulatory oversight activities, including reporting and escalation of operations matters across jurisdictions and legal entities.
* Drive process improvements across break resolution, including identifying automation and matching enhancement opportunities.
* Partner with Operations, Product, Change Management, and Technology teams to define needs and deliver solutions that improve break resolution outcomes.
* Prepare and deliver stakeholder presentations that communicate priorities, progress, issues, and decisions.
* Maintain clear, well-documented communication across internal teams by reviewing and updating standard operating procedures and service level agreements to ensure consistency.
* Execute periodic spot checks to confirm the effectiveness and consistency of controls and breaks management processes.
* Analyze key themes and drivers of breaks to support control reviews, updates, and adherence.
* Lead regular one-to-ones and team meetings to share changes impacting the team, including market, functional, procedural, and service updates.

**Required qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* Demonstrate strong custody operations experience across operations delivery, program management, or risk and control.
* Apply program management standards and methods to plan, execute, and track work in a controlled environment.
* Communicate clearly in writing and verbally with management, clients, and colleagues.
* Build relationships with a wide range of stakeholders across the firm.
* Deliver results in a risk-based environment with a track record of risk reduction.
* Execute effectively in a changing environment by learning, documenting, and implementing new processes efficiently.
* Prioritize competing demands through strong time management, multi-tasking, and attention to detail.
* Utilize advanced Microsoft Excel, Word, and PowerPoint skills to support analysis, documentation, and presentations.
* Demonstrate strategic and analytical thinking to assess issues and propose practical remediation actions.
* Lead team communication routines through structured updates, clear expectations, and consistent follow-through.

**Preferred qualifications, skills, and capabilities:**

* Hold a relevant degree or demonstrate an equivalent track record of performance in a similar role.
* Demonstrate financial services experience, ideally within custody or an investment banking environment.
* Show experience managing global teams within custody operations, including exposure to trades, settlements, lending, asset servicing, or middle office activities.
* Apply proficiency with tools such as Tableau and Alteryx to support operational insights and monitoring.
* Demonstrate project management skills that support planning, governance, and delivery.
* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

**ABOUT US**  
  
  

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

  
  
**ABOUT THE TEAM**
  
  
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.
